summary: P3: the_drift_check_fails_on_each_planted_change plants seven kinds of drift: a missing row, a wrong digest, an undeclared row, the atip header, a lost call, an added rule and the searcher text. It misses two kinds the brief lists. (1) A stored call that no longer breaks its rule: judge_call is never made to fail. (2) A change to an argument field the digest covers (possibleValues, valueName, valueType, required, a SAMPLES value or an example word). The added-rule case asserts only no row, and that would still hold if digest_of stopped hashing doc constraints. Fix: plant a violate row whose found.assignment breaks nothing and expect does not break; then change possibleValues or required of a rule-named argument in an in-memory document and expect made from other inputs.
